brief: JS-033's open questions after Refine and the Jellyfin 12.4 capture.
tradeoff: Operators cannot delete or rename that account from a client while it is configured, and jellyfin-web shows nothing on the refusal.
entry: The configured admin cannot be deleted or renamed through the API while configured; demote and disable are allowed; start-up refuses a commonly guessed admin password only when it creates the account.
serves: 'Settings are declared in configuration'; 'every failure is reported with its reason'.
